title:
HDB prices dipped.
*$1M flats hit a record*

lines.say: You heard HDB resale prices are falling. They dipped for a third quarter in a row. But that's not the whole story.
In the third quarter of 2026, prices slipped about 0.1%.
Yet more flats changed hands: 7,645, up about 20% from the quarter before.
And about 600 flats sold for a million dollars or more. A quarterly record.
So the average barely moved, but the top end kept climbing.
Your flat's value depends on your town, block and floor, not the headline.

caption:
Heard HDB resale prices are falling? They dipped for a third quarter in a row, about 0.1% in Q3 2026. But that's not the whole story. 🏠

More flats changed hands: 7,645, up about 20% from Q2. And about 600 flats sold for $1M or more, a quarterly record. The average barely moved, but the top end kept climbing.

Your flat's value depends on your town, block and floor, not the headline.

Comment your flat type and town, and we'll tell you where yours sits 👇

HDB Q3 2026 data, released 23 Oct 2026.
